caption: The drawing depicts a small, pouch-like bag with a rounded body and a gathered top, closed with two twisted red cords that end in knots on each side. The main body of the bag is a deep red color and is decorated with an embroidered design featuring various colorful objects. At the top portion, there are green leaves interspersed with blue, pink, and yellow flowers, as well as a yellow and orange butterfly. Lower on the bag, there is a landscape scene with a blue house and a yellow house, both with black details, and a blue structure with a pointed roof, set on a green base. Two trees with green tops and pale brown trunks are situated on either side of the houses. The entire bag is set against a plain, off-white background with no other visible objects or designs.
title: Bag
